item.title: The q-wedge relations coincide with the type-A energy braiding kernel
item.statement:
Put a=Y1/Y2 and let P flip the two tensor factors INCLUDING their loop variables. On the fixed-coproduct affine tensor module define the completed normalized R by the LEFT coefficient formula R_fix=(q²−a)^-1[(a−1)S+q²−1], expanded with psi_fix=1−q²/a. Then R_fix swaps Y1,Y2, fixes every extremal u⊗u, commutes with the fixed U action, and obeys the normalized Yang-Baxter equation. The polynomial-cleared operator has
psi_fix(R_fix−1)=(a^-1−1)(S+1).
Multiplication by a^-1−1 is injective on the original Laurent-loop module, hence its kernel is EXACTLY Ker(S+1) there. Define R_op=P R_fix P, psi_op=1−q²a. This is KMPY's MAIN bar-Delta-plus (OPPOSITE our Delta) channel, with source b_j→our b_(j+1), source ground indexk→u_(1−k). Its q0 leading term is z^H_op b1⊗z^-H_op b2 and psi_op≡1 modq. Its source kernel N_op=P Ker(S+1) is the U_op/symmetric-loop orbit of an extremal diagonal, with C_(j,k)=v_j⊗z^-chi(j>k)v_k+q z^-chi(j>k)v_k⊗v_j (j≠k) and C_(j,j)=v_j⊗v_j. Flip gives the fixed quotient and all its promised R/energy content. It is not asserted that flip identifies the source's A0 descending-wedge chart with our descending chart; that actual chart is proved locally next.
item.strategy: From the Bernstein formula write S=S0 s+(1−q²)Y2(1−s)/(Y1−Y2), with s exchanging loops. Substitution gives R_fix=[(a−1)S0+q²−1]/(q²−a)·s; thus the loop-swap identities are literal and the diagonal S0 eigen−1 gives normalization1. The denominator psi_fix has constant1 atq0, so the geometric q-adic series is legitimate even though a weight space of the affinized tensor can be infinite. Multiplication by loop functions commutes with U-prime, the combination of S and identity intertwines U-prime, and ratios a have total d-degree0; hence R intertwines the full affine module. Keep coefficients LEFT: subtract identity and clear the denominator to get the displayed equality. No original Laurent vector is lost by clearing psi; a^-1−1 is nonzero in the Laurent domain acting freely, proving the stated kernel before localization. For Yang-Baxter, use the FINITE RESIDUE operators S0_i and external commuting scalar variables x,y: B_i(x)=(x−1)S0_i+(Q−1), Q=q². This is the R0(a) numerator after R_fix=R0(a)·s_loop; it is not a polynomial expansion of the full affine S_i against noncommuting loop a. Expanding B_i(x)B_j(xy)B_i(y), reduce S0_i²=(Q−1)S0_i+Q and the finite residue braid. The coefficients of the eight resulting Hecke words match the opposite expansion because (x−1)(y−1)+(x−1)+(y−1)=xy−1; the scalar denominators are the same commuting product. Loop permutations supply x,y,xy, so this is the completed operator identity. Flip proves the OP statements. Atq0 the OP fundamental cases j>k,j=k,j<k respectively give loop factors a,1,1 before the loop swap, hence H_op=chi(j>k)+secondPower−firstPower; this is an actual matrix calculation, not missing KMN input. The C vectors follow by the l=0,±1 Bernstein formulas and are in the diagonal orbit: two consecutive F moves reach every diagonal, one move gives adjacent C, and continuing around the cycle gives each C with the required0-edge shift. Common loop shifts and symmetric powers Y1^n+Y2^n extend these base cases to every gap; subtract their leading bad pair and induct on the gap as in the full straightening recurrence, proving generation. The source energy/ground/coproduct displays were visually pinned; the native claim that R COMMUTES with individual loops is replaced by the actual SWAP.
